info.name: CinemaAPI
info.description:
Auth api - allows login, change password and activate created account

User api - allows get user info, registration, logout, getAllUsers, edit user info

Movie api - allow get, filter, create, edit, delete movies; load poster for movies; get, create, delete, edit genres

Hall api - allows get, create, edit, delete halls  
Hall\`s seat api - allows get seat/seats; delete seat; create, edit seats  
Session API - allows get session; filter session by movie/date; get all session seats; create, edit, delete session;

Ticket api - allow get tickets of specified user; get qr code of specified ticket; create ticket;

item.name: Auth API
item.description:
UserLogin - sends email and password - get access and refresh jwt tokens  
Request Recovery Password - sends email - get letter on specified email with recovery link  
Recovery change password - sends token and email - changes password  
Refresh Token - sends email token - get new pair of token  
User Activation - sends token - activates account

item.name: UserAPI
item.description:
Get my user info - needs access token - returns information about user itself  
RegUser - sends email, password (profile info optional) - returns letter on specified email with activation link  
LogOut - needs refresh token - puts token into blacklist(logout from account)  
GetAllUser - needs access token(for staff only) - return paginatied user list  
Edit user info - needs access token, and information what will be changed - return

item.name: MovieAPI
item.description:
get all movies - returns all movies  
get movie by id - returns specified movie  
get movie by filter - sends parameters for filter - returns filtered movies  
create movie - needs access token(only staff), sends data about film - return created film  
  
change movie info - needs access token(only staff), sends part or full changed data about film - return changed film  
  
delete movie by id - needs access token(only staff), - deletes specified movie  
load picture - needs access token(only staff), sends file  
get all genres - return all genres  
create genre - needs access token(only staff), sends genre_name - creates genre  
get genre by id - returns specified genre  
delete genre by id - needs access token(only staff) - deletes specified genre  
edit genre by id - needs access token(only staff), sends changed genre_name - changes specified genre

item.name: HallsAPI
item.description:
get all halls - return all halls  
create hall - needs access token(only staff), sends data - returns created hall  
change hall info by id - needs access token(only staff), sends part or full changed data - returns changed hall  
  
delete hall by id - needs access token(only staff) - deletes specified hall

item.name: Hall`s seats API
Get all seats by hall id

item.description:
get all seats by hall id - returns all seats of specified hall

get seat by id - returns specified seat  
delete seat - _**needs access token(only staff) -**_ deletes specified seat by its id

create seat/seats - _**needs access token(only staff),**_ sends bulk data- create 1 or more seats in specified hall  
  
change seat info by seat_ID - _**needs access token(only staff),**_ can be bulk \- edit specified seat by its id

item.name: Sessions API
Get all sessions by movie id

item.description:
get all session - returns all session  
get all session by movie id - returns session filtered by movie ID  
get all session by date - returns session filtered by date  
get all seats by session ID - returns all seats in specified session  
Create session - _**needs access token(only staff),**_ sends session data - returns created session

Edit session by id - _**needs access token(only staff),**_ sends changed session data - returns edited session

Delete Session by id - _**needs access token(only staff), -**_ deletes specified session

item.name: Tickets API
item.description:
get tickets - needs access token(authenticated users) - returns all tickets of specified user  
get ticket QR - needs access token(authenticated users) - returns qr of specified uuid  
create ticket - needs access token(authenticated users), sends data of ticker - returns created ticket  
ticket validation(currently disabled on API) - needs access token(staff only), sends ticket uuid - changes ticket status
